'''Ruusan copper''' was a type of [[Copper/Legends|copper]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Parella Jiramma Baco]] possessed a suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was constructed from [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] copper, which he once wore while on a quest on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]], to hunt down the [[Unidentified Gorach artist|last member]] of the [[Gorach]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
